A personal appeal from the SCP Foundation 05-█

I got a lot of funny looks ██ years ago when I started talking to [REDACTED] about the Foundation.
Let’s just say some people were skeptical of the notion that volunteers from all across the world could come together to create a remarkable protocol for storing anomalous and potentially harmful objects – all for the simple purpose of securing, containing and protecting.
No profits. No government intervention. No strings attached.
██ years after its founding, nearly █████ people are employed in Site 19 and its sister sites every month - almost a third of the ███████ █████.
It is the 5th largest building in the world - but Site 19 isn’t anything like a commercial activity. It is a Foundation creation, funded by government money one siphoned dollar at a time. You are part of our Foundation. And I’m writing today to ask you to protect and sustain it.
Together, we can keep it securing potentially threatening phenomena. We can keep it containing threats to human existence. We can keep it observing, detaining and destroying any one or thing that prevents us from obtaining out goal. We can keep SCP-682 in his goddamn containment chamber for 3 days in a row.
Each year at this time, we reach out to ask you and others all across the Foundation sites to help sustain our joint enterprise with the US government with a modest donation of $20, $35, $50 million or more.
If you value the SCP Foundation as the saviour of humanity – and the source of your monthly paycheck – I hope you’ll choose to act right now.
All the best,
█████████ █████ █████
05-█, SCP Foundation
P.S. The Foundation is about the power of people like us to contain extraordinary things that threaten our civilisation. People like us save the world, one expendable D-Class personnel at a time. People like us (well, almost) fund it, one donation at a time. It's proof of our collective potential to change the world.


Clumsy take on Jimmy Wales' appeal, but that one is better.
